<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920519_theRebbe_475" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920519_theRebbe_475__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the header and date for the maamar, including the Torah portion and the Hebrew date.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven,</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbos Parshas Nitzavim-Vayeilech,</t>
    <t s="2">the 25th of Elul*,</t>
    <t s="3">the year 5716</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section notes that the maamar is an unedited draft.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">(Unedited draft)</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the verse "You are standing today, all of you" refers to Rosh Hashanah, the Day of Judgment, and that standing signifies being vindicated in judgment.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"You are standing today, all of you, before Hashem your G-d: your heads, your tribes, etc., from the hewer of your wood to the drawer of your water."</t>
    <t s="1">Now, this portion</t>
    <t s="2">is always read before Rosh Hashanah.</t>
    <t s="3">And it is hinted in the word "today" that it refers to Rosh Hashanah,</t>
    <t s="4">as it is stated</t>
    <t s="5">by our teacher who received from his teacher the Maggid, and his teacher from his teacher the Baal Shem Tov, that "today" refers to Rosh Hashanah,</t>
    <t s="6">which is the Day of Judgment,</t>
    <t s="7">and as it is stated,</t>
    <t s="8">"And it was the day,"</t>
    <t s="9">and the Targum translates: "And it was the great Day of Judgment,"</t>
    <t s="10">for Rosh Hashanah is the day of judgment and justice,</t>
    <t s="11">and this is the blessing: "You are standing today, all of you,"</t>
    <t s="12">that you, all of you, from your heads, your tribes, to the hewer of your wood and the drawer of your water,</t>
    <t s="13">are standing, enduring and existing,</t>
    <t s="14">meaning that they are vindicated in judgment.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
